No new sensor or inference algorithm; the treatment itself is the intervention
Validates via direct XRD residual-stress measurement rather than detection-time-window analysis
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to reduce fatigue crack initiation at a high-stress-gradient wheel-seat fillet without changing the axle geometry, which is constrained by bogie packaging.
parsed.viable_reason: Ultrasonic impact treatment genuinely induces surface compressive residual stresses of the claimed magnitude in axle steels and is testable via XRD, and it directly targets the fillet fatigue initiation mechanism without geometry change.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: None of the prior art applies a surface residual-stress mitigation to the initiation site; all three pursue indirect monitoring/inference, so substituting a direct peening-type treatment is not an obvious routine extension of their approach.
